text: One of the decent dental clinics, good modern service, friendly staff, oral examination for 100 baht, they don't push bad options, and they tell you right away what they guarantee and what they don't. Another dental clinic offered a crown for 18,000 rubles, but without a guarantee, but here they didn't, and when I asked about a crown, they explained in detail why they ruled out that option and why they didn't offer it! Plus, my terrifying fear of dental treatment disappears here; the doctors are very attentive! Thank you ❤️
